pairs.why: A's green slide, blue ladder and yellow deck are mid-chroma on a pink wave background like the real card, while B's saturated cyan water and yellow pillar add an extra loud hue family.
The two ropes have identical purple background, golden rope and red accent, so color gives no reason to choose.
B keeps a magenta/purple background with a purple floor, matching the real cards' saturated colorful backdrops, while A has a gray-white floor and a more washed pink.
A's green stripes and cool blue-white airflow are closer to the real card's mid-green with soft cyan, while B's yellow-green wash pulls warm and loses chroma.
A's sand and sea are slightly more saturated and the cooler red cooler reads like the real card's, while B is duller and lower in chroma.
A's navy body with cyan and white keys has strong blue/yellow contrast like the real calculator, while B's darker blues and muddier keys are slightly duller.
A's cyan controls and violet headphones sit against orange with a cool/warm contrast and a warm reflective floor like the real card, while B has a slightly darker, redder floor.
A's teal-to-blue background with a muted steel truss matches the real card's teal-blue field, while B's brighter cyan and orange accents are louder.
